description: Higher-colour Schur-Weyl foreclosure for the WRT->W_lambda keystone route (#2608 follow-up). The gl_d colour-multiplicity m_d(lambda)=#SSYT(lambda,<=d) cannot equal the q-Plancherel W_lambda for any d: support {rows<=d} misses W's 4/5-row blocks for d<5, and m_d is conjugation-asymmetric (peaks at one-row (5), the production y_lambda direction) while W_lambda=W_{lambda'} peaks at (3,1,1). No fit; structural foreclosure.
verdict: HIGHER-COLOUR DOES NOT RESCUE THE ROUTE. The colour-multiplicity Schur-Weyl weight m_d(lambda) (#SSYT, = dim L^{gl_d}_lambda) (i) has support {rows<=d}, missing W_lambda's 4-row/5-row blocks for d<5; and (ii) is strongly conjugation-ASYMMETRIC (e.g. m_5(5)=126 vs m_5(1^5)=1), peaking away from the Plancherel (3,1,1) (gl_d dimension peaks at (4,1); principal-spec limit at the one-row (5)) - the production direction, whereas W_lambda is conjugation-symmetric and peaks at (3,1,1). No d (finite or ->infinity) makes m_d symmetric, so no colour weighting equals the Plancherel W_lambda. The WRT-colour Schur-Weyl functor lands the PRODUCTION weight family, not the Plancherel target. W_lambda needs the SYMMETRIC pairing d_q(lambda)^2 (full Hecke, d->infinity) — not a finite-colour WRT image. Route foreclosed; loops to #2406 (no finite colour-SU(3) arena) / #2409 (infinite-dim full-Hecke).
discipline: No fit; structural foreclosure (search prune), not a keystone closure. Owner closes (bean s5bb section 4a).
